Generate Python code based on the following instruction. Output ONLY code. DO NOT include explanations or other textual content.
Instruction: Generate code that creates an emulation environment using the seedemu library. The environment should include multiple layers such as Base, Routing, Ebgp, Ibgp, Ospf, and WebService. It should create several Internet Exchanges with custom display names. It should also create Transit Autonomous Systems and single-homed stub Autonomous Systems with various services. The code should also add a host with a customized IP address to one of the Autonomous Systems and create a real-world Autonomous System. It should enable remote access to one of the Autonomous System's network. The code should also set up peering via a route server and private peering with different peer relationships. Finally, the code should add all the layers to the emulator, save the emulator to a component file, and render and compile the emulator.

You can find the following APIs from the library helpful:
shouldMerge, createAutonomousSystem, AutonomousSystem, PoAServer, makeEmulatorBaseWith5StubASAndHosts, makeEmulatorBaseWith10StubASAndHosts, setAutonomousSystem, getAutonomousSystem, __configureAutonomousSystem, ScionAutonomousSystem, doesAContainB, makeStubAsWithHosts, getNodeByAsnAndName, addPrivatePeering, up_emulator, to_json, toGraphviz, resolveTo, get_balance_with_name, createEmulation

```python
from seedemu import Emulator
from seedemu.layers import Base, Routing, Ebgp, Ibgp, Ospf, WebService
from seedemu.core import AutonomousSystem, InternetExchange, Host, Network, ServiceType

# Create the emulator and layers
emu = Emulator()
base = Base()
routing = Routing()
ebgp = Ebgp()
ibgp = Ibgp()
ospf = Ospf()
web = WebService()

# Create Internet Exchanges with custom display names
ix1 = InternetExchange(1, displayName="IX - North America")
ix2 = InternetExchange(2, displayName="IX - Europe")
ix3 = InternetExchange(3, displayName="IX - Asia")
base.addInternetExchange(ix1)
base.addInternetExchange(ix2)
base.addInternetExchange(ix3)

# Create Transit Autonomous Systems
transit_as1 = AutonomousSystem(100, displayName="Transit AS 100")
transit_as2 = AutonomousSystem(200, displayName="Transit AS 200")
base.addAutonomousSystem(transit_as1)
base.addAutonomousSystem(transit_as2)

# Create single-homed stub Autonomous Systems with various services
stub_as1 = AutonomousSystem(101, displayName="Stub AS 101")
stub_as2 = AutonomousSystem(102, displayName="Stub AS 102")
stub_as3 = AutonomousSystem(103, displayName="Stub AS 103")
base.addAutonomousSystem(stub_as1)
base.addAutonomousSystem(stub_as2)
base.addAutonomousSystem(stub_as3)

# Add hosts and services to stub ASes
host1 = Host("host1")
host2 = Host("host2")
host3 = Host("host3")
stub_as1.addHost(host1)
stub_as2.addHost(host2)
stub_as3.addHost(host3)
web.addService("host1", 101, ServiceType.Web)
web.addService("host2", 102, ServiceType.Web)
web.addService("host3", 103, ServiceType.Web)

# Add a host with a customized IP address to one of the Autonomous Systems
custom_host = Host("customHost")
custom_host.addIp("10.10.10.10/24")
stub_as1.addHost(custom_host)
web.addService("customHost", 101, ServiceType.Web)

# Create a real-world Autonomous System
real_as = AutonomousSystem(64512, displayName="Real-World AS 64512")
base.addAutonomousSystem(real_as)
real_host = Host("realHost")
real_as.addHost(real_host)
web.addService("realHost", 64512, ServiceType.Web)

# Enable remote access to one of the Autonomous System's network
stub_as2.enableRemoteAccess()

# Connect ASes to Internet Exchanges
ix1.addParticipant(100)
ix1.addParticipant(101)
ix2.addParticipant(200)
ix2.addParticipant(102)
ix3.addParticipant(103)
ix3.addParticipant(64512)

# Set up peering via a route server (IX1)
ebgp.addRouteServer(1, [100, 101])

# Set up private peering with different peer relationships
ebgp.addPrivatePeering(100, 200, relationship="transit")
ebgp.addPrivatePeering(100, 101, relationship="peer")
ebgp.addPrivatePeering(200, 102, relationship="transit")
ebgp.addPrivatePeering(103, 64512, relationship="peer")

# Add IGP (OSPF) and iBGP within transit ASes
ospf.addArea(100, 0)
ospf.addArea(200, 0)
ibgp.addFullMesh(100)
ibgp.addFullMesh(200)

# Add all layers to the emulator
emu.addLayer(base)
emu.addLayer(routing)
emu.addLayer(ebgp)
emu.addLayer(ibgp)
emu.addLayer(ospf)
emu.addLayer(web)

# Save the emulator to a component file
emu.save("emulation-component.bin")

# Render and compile the emulator
emu.render()
emu.compile()
```
